table.lm_encoding: lm=0: at habitat, nothing visited. lm = 1 + (loc-1)*256 + m8, where m8 = visited mask with bit (loc-1) removed (bits below loc-1 kept, bits above shifted down by one). Mask bit k-1 = target k visited; target k = locations[k].
table.action_encoding: 0 = return home (at habitat start: stay home), 1..9 = go to target k (walk + base work), 10 = extend science here (+15 min, once per stop)
table.rle: row = (cls*2 + ext)*n_lm + lm; runs[offsets[row] .. offsets[row+1]) are uint16 (r_start << 4 | action), r_start = remaining suit minutes (integer, floor) at which that action starts to apply; pick the last run with r_start <= floor(remaining). offsets_b64 = little-endian uint32, runs_b64 = little-endian uint16.
